declarations.text: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto
ALTER TABLE project ADD CONSTRAINT project_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) > 0 AND char_length(name) <= 1024)
ALTER TABLE nature ADD CONSTRAINT nature_name_length CHECK (char_length(name) > 0 AND char_length(name) <= 1024)
ALTER TABLE semantic_data_domain ADD CONSTRAINT semantic_data_domain_uri_length CHECK (char_length(uri) > 0)

INSERT INTO representation_content (
                id,
                content,
                last_migration_performed,
                migration_version,
                created_on,
                last_modified_on
            )
            SELECT
                representationData.id,
                representationData.content,
                representationData.last_migration_performed,
                representationData.migration_version,
                representationData.created_on,
                representationData.last_modified_on
            FROM representation_data representationData

INSERT INTO project_semantic_data (id, project_id, semantic_data_id, name, created_on, last_modified_on)
            SELECT gen_random_uuid(), project_id, id, 'main' AS name, created_on, last_modified_on FROM semantic_data

UPDATE representation_metadata
            SET semantic_data_id = projectSemanticData.semantic_data_id
            FROM project_semantic_data projectSemanticData
            WHERE representation_metadata.project_id = projectSemanticData.project_id AND projectSemanticData.name = 'main'

UPDATE document
			SET is_read_only = TRUE
			FROM library
			WHERE document.semantic_data_id = library.semantic_data_id

UPDATE document
			SET is_read_only = FALSE
			FROM project_semantic_data projectSemanticData
			WHERE document.semantic_data_id = projectSemanticData.semantic_data_id

UPDATE representation_content
            SET semantic_data_id = representationMetadata.semantic_data_id
            FROM representation_metadata representationMetadata
            WHERE representation_content.id = representationMetadata.id

UPDATE representation_content
            SET representation_metadata_id = representationMetadata.id
            FROM representation_metadata representationMetadata
            WHERE representation_content.id = representationMetadata.id

UPDATE representation_metadata_icon_url
            SET semantic_data_id = representationMetadata.semantic_data_id
            FROM representation_metadata representationMetadata
            WHERE representation_metadata_icon_url.representation_metadata_id = representationMetadata.representation_metadata_id
